title: Single Sign-on
seo: Single sign-on (SSO) with SAML and OIDC
meta: Let business customers sign in with their own identity provider using SAML or OpenID Connect. From $250, delivered in 7 days or less.
overview: Larger customers often ask whether their staff can use the company login. We add single sign-on to your product so they can connect Okta, Microsoft Entra, Google Workspace or another identity provider. We build the connection screen for the customer's admin, map the user details, handle first-time sign-in and test it against a real test directory. We give your support team a simple guide for each customer.

faq: Do I need SSO or is a login service enough?
Small products often do not. Start when a customer asks. If you use Auth0, WorkOS or Clerk, they offer SSO features, and we can configure those instead of coding it.
Any provider that supports SAML 2.0 or OpenID Connect, including Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace and OneLogin. We test the ones listed in your package.
Can I charge more for SSO?
Many products offer it on a higher plan. That is a pricing choice for you, and we can tie it to your plan setup if you use our billing services.
Do you need access to my customers' systems?
No. Each customer's own IT admin sets up their side using our guide. We use test directories we create ourselves, and never ask for any customer's passwords.
